**A.** The deposition is admissible as former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1): the engineer is unavailable, and the company, the party against whom it is offered, examined him through its attorney in the earlier deposition on the same safety-report and structural-defect issues, so it had opportunity and similar motive. The team note is wrong that the company had no motive to cross-examine: it was the defendant in the wrongful-termination suit and deposed him there. Testimony given at a deposition in another action fits 804(b)(1)'s "testimony given... at another hearing," so it is neither barred hearsay nor inadmissible for lack of cross-examination.

CONFIDENCE: 75
